title: Cheaply made and doesn't work
text: Cheaply made and doesn't work. This doesn't work at all. I put ice and water in the bottom and it never got cold. The fan itself is extremely weak. I could barely feel a light breeze when I put my hand 1 inch away from the device. Complete waste of money!!!!
